title: Stress the contrastive batch
description: Choose a batch condition, then change the global batch and logit scale. Watch negative count, score-matrix cost, false-negative pressure, and symmetric loss move for different reasons.

scenarios.label: Distinct clean pairs
scenarios.detail: Every off-diagonal caption describes a visibly different concept.
scenarios.observation: The diagonal is clearly separated, so increasing scale lowers the illustrative loss without creating a ranking error.
scenarios.recommendation: Use this as a healthy geometry check, not proof that the real data has no duplicate concepts.

scenarios.label: Valid alternative captions
scenarios.detail: Two dog images have different paired captions, but each off-diagonal caption is also semantically valid.
scenarios.observation: The diagonal can remain top-1 while the loss punishes a valid off-diagonal match. Higher scale makes that false-negative penalty sharper.
scenarios.recommendation: Deduplicate near-identical content, preserve multi-positive identity, or use a loss that can represent known alternative positives.

scenarios.label: One noisy positive
scenarios.detail: The third image was paired with the wrong caption during ingestion.
scenarios.observation: A declared diagonal positive loses to another caption. Increasing scale raises confidence in the current ranking and makes the mislabeled pair more expensive.
scenarios.recommendation: Inspect high-loss pairs, repair pair lineage, and avoid treating temperature changes as a data-quality fix.
